name: automated-firmware-skills
description: Gated MCU firmware workflows (tools check, project, IDE, build, flash, test, debug) per toolchain, framework and board. Install one vendor plugin (it pulls in firmware-tools) or the all-in-one plugin - not both.

plugins.name: automated-firmware-skills
plugins.description: All board skills and tool skills in one plugin: ModusToolbox (Edgi-Talk), STM32CubeMX / CubeMX2 (NUCLEO-C562RE, B-L475E-IOT01A, STM32N6570-DK, STM32F407G-DISC1, NUCLEO-WB55RG), PlatformIO (Pico 2 W, ESP32-S3-BOX x2, UNO R4 WiFi), RT-Thread (Vision Board, Titan Board), MCUXpresso SDK (FRDM-MCXN947), plus web-wizard, cleanroom-test, sensor-debug, hw-troubleshooting.

plugins.name: firmware-tools
plugins.description: Board-independent tool skills used by every firmware plugin: web-wizard (browser forms), cleanroom-test (fresh-agent doc check), sensor-debug (PC-side checks and live view of a board's console), hw-troubleshooting (firmware vs setup vs hardware).

plugins.name: firmware-stm32
plugins.description: ST boards with STM32CubeMX 6.18 or CubeMX2, the STM32Cube HAL, CMake and STM32CubeProgrammer / ST-LINK: NUCLEO-C562RE, B-L475E-IOT01A, NUCLEO-WB55RG, STM32F407G-DISC1 (no test stage yet) and STM32N6570-DK (build stages).

plugins.name: firmware-platformio
plugins.description: PlatformIO boards: Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W (arduino-pico), ESP32-S3-BOX (ESP-IDF and Arduino) and Arduino UNO R4 WiFi.

plugins.name: firmware-modustoolbox
plugins.description: Infineon PSOC Edge E84 on the RT-Thread Edgi-Talk with ModusToolbox 3.9 (PDL, KitProg3 / OpenOCD).

plugins.name: firmware-rtthread
plugins.description: RT-Thread Vision Board (Renesas RA8D1, RT-Thread 5.0.2) and Titan Board (Renesas RA8P1, RT-Thread 5.1.0) with scons and the RT-Thread Studio SDK (pyOCD); Kconfig-level driver recipes.

plugins.name: firmware-mcuxpresso
plugins.description: NXP FRDM-MCXN947 (MCX N, Cortex-M33) with the MCUXpresso SDK 26.09 (west), CMake and MCUXpresso for VS Code, LinkServer / MCU-Link - NXP tools only.
